title: Randi's million-dollar challenge was really a 30-year payout he judged himself

tellings.quote: regard to the amazing Randy M the payoff was not a million dollar M it was an investment that would pay you eventually

related.note: Both are about James Randi's paranormal challenge. The stored story claims the prize was really a 30-year payout that Randi judged himself, while this telling presents it as a straightforward cash prize that began at $10,000.

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man known for remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe faraway places with the mind alone, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about James Randi, a stage magician who offered a million dollars to anyone who could prove a paranormal power. McMoneagle says the prize was not a million dollars in hand but an investment that would pay out over about 30 years, and that Randi judged the tests himself. If so, the famous challenge would be less fair than it sounds.
